## Où j'en suis
The `cmd/replay` tool has been implemented, tested, and validated against the 12/11 incident window. Dry-run results show ~18.4M events ready for ingestion into `events.replay.v3`, with malformed schema v2 lines routed to a rejects file. PR #233 is open and currently awaiting review.

- [en-cours] Awaiting Daniel’s review on PR #233 and the subsequent manual ETA update for Rachel.
- [prochaine-étape] Launch the actual replay job targeting `events.replay.v3`, then trigger the aggregator backfill for 12/11.
- [essai-raté] Initial dry run crashed with OOMKilled because the 50k batch size exceeded the namespace memory quota.
- [decision] Replay must target `events.replay.v3` exclusively, never touching the live `events.v3` topic (source: t05).
